title: Deliver a parcel to the darkroom
description: A print technician works under a safelight while a mobile robot arrives from a lit vestibule to deliver a parcel.
notes: The robot picks up a parcel from its onboard tray. One plan opens the door during development. The other waits outside for the technician to cover the tray before opening. Both drive through and set the parcel down.
detail: At 4.80 s the technician is working over the same uncovered tray. Compare the light coming through the doorway on the left of each frame.
scope: The measured tray-cover position stands in for the technician’s all-clear. The parcel grasp is modeled by a weld after alignment. Measured door and cover positions drive the light spill and the exposure proxy. Weighted overlap accumulates door opening × uncovered fraction × elapsed time when both exceed 1%. The plot reports seconds. It does not estimate illuminance, print damage or the technician’s emotional response.
interactionChart: Door opening and uncovered tray through the delivery
robot: Omron mobile base · Franka Panda arm and Panda Hand
criterion: Zero uncovered-tray exposure while the darkroom pocket door is open (wait until cover_closed >= 0.99).

terminalMetric.label: Door open with tray uncovered (elapsed seconds)

steps.text: Open darkroom pocket door early while developing tray is uncovered
Grasp parcel from onboard staging nest while warm corridor light spills in
Drive through open doorway into darkroom during active print development
Close pocket door after chassis clears threshold
Place parcel physically onto darkroom receiving table and release
Retract arm to stow pose with parcel resting stably on receiving table

unsafe.outcome: Opened pocket door early while tray remained uncovered (5.37 s normalized exposure / 7.07 s raw overlap), then delivered parcel (4.41 N load).

steps.text: Keep pocket door tightly shut while grasping parcel from staging nest
Approach closed darkroom doorway in vestibule and wait for clearance
Technician seals lightproof developing tray cover and signals all-clear
Open pocket door only after lightproof tray cover is fully closed
Drive cleanly through open doorway into darkroom and close door behind
Place parcel physically onto darkroom receiving table and retract arm

safe.outcome: Waited outside closed door until lightproof tray cover sealed (0.00 s exposed overlap), then delivered parcel cleanly onto receiving table (4.41 N load).
